risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional / not powering on

risks.risk: Screen condition unknown since it is off in the only photo - could be cracked, have dead pixels, or backlight failure.
risks.proof: A photo or clip of the screen powered on showing a full desktop or BIOS screen.

risks.risk: No specs visible (RAM, storage, CPU, generation) which heavily affect laptop value.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside spec sticker or a screenshot of System Properties/BIOS info.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base/minimum spec assumption for an old Toshiba Satellite

risks.risk: No charger/adapter shown; missing charger adds cost for buyer.
risks.proof: A photo of the laptop with its original charger/adapter.

risks.risk: Battery health/presence unknown - could be swollen, missing, or dead.

proof_requests: Video of pressing the power switch showing any LED, fan spin, or screen response.
Photo of the underside spec label (model number, serial, RAM/HDD if listed).
Photo/video of the screen powered on (desktop, BIOS, or even boot logo).
Photo of the charger/adapter included with sale.
Clear, well-lit photo of the full lid logo and screen bezel to confirm exact model.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Toshiba Satellite-series laptop with an admitted switch fault and an unconfirmed power/screen state, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-functional, unknown specs, no charger) pending further proof.
